title: The builder's own instructed remedy for WORKFLOW_PROMPT_BOTH saves `prompt: ""` beside `prompt_file:` — validates GREEN, then fails at run
line: 94-103 (copy + its claim); LlmStepForm.tsx:31, AgentStepForm.tsx:71, LlmMapStepForm.tsx:61 (patch({prompt: v}) with v=''); WorkflowBuilder.store.ts:388-396 (Object.assign, no normalisation), :56-68 (toWorkflowDef verbatim); server/src/modules/workflow/validate.rs:681-698 (has_prompt filters '' -> NO finding); server/src/modules/workflow/dispatch.rs:106-115 (load_raw_prompt `_` arm)
evidence: EXECUTED (node --import ./scripts/node-test-loader.mjs): configErrors({kind:'llm',prompt:'',prompt_file:'p.md',output_format:'text'}) => {} — the client reports nothing. READ PATH: validate.rs:681 `let has_prompt = prompt.as_ref().filter(|s| !s.is_empty()).is_some();` so Some("") => has_prompt=false, has_file=true => neither WORKFLOW_PROMPT_BOTH (683) nor WORKFLOW_PROMPT_MISSING (691) fires; the panel renders 'No blocking errors.' (BuilderValidationPanel.tsx:167) and Save is enabled. StepConfig declares `prompt: Option<String>` with `skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none"` (validate.rs:152-156), so Some("") IS serialized into workflow.yaml. At RUN time dispatch.rs:106-115 matches only (Some,None) and (None,Some); (Some(""),Some(rel)) falls to `_ => Err(format!("step '{}' has invalid prompt config", step.id))` — for llm (dispatch.rs:145), llm_map (dispatch.rs:356) and agent (agent_dispatch.rs:1101) alike.
failure_mode: Author opens an imported `prompt_file:` step, types into the prompt box (which round 7's PROMPT_FROM_FILE_NOTE explicitly invites: 'Type something to override it'), gets WORKFLOW_PROMPT_BOTH, and follows the builder's own remedy — validationCopy.ts:102-103 'clear the prompt box here to use the file'. Clearing the Textarea fires onChange('') -> patch({prompt: ''}). The step now carries prompt:"" + prompt_file. Panel goes green, Save succeeds, workflow.yaml persists `prompt: ""`. The run then fails the step with the wire string "step 'llm_1' has invalid prompt config" — an INV-1 leak at the run surface, reached by obeying INV-6 copy that is false in effect. The comment at validationCopy.ts:96-99 asserts the opposite ('Clearing the box is the reachable fix and it really does resolve the finding'); it is true of validate.rs and false of dispatch.rs. No test covers either half: grep for 'invalid prompt config' matches only dispatch.rs:114, and validate.rs's rejects_prompt_and_prompt_file (1675-1687) only covers a NON-empty prompt.
scope_note: Fix is frontend-only and in scope (DESIGN §3 forbids changing backend messages/codes/severity and run-time behavior, neither of which is needed): emit `undefined`/`null` instead of '' for the prompt when the value is blank — the codebase already does exactly this one field away, AgentStepForm.tsx:154 `patch({ system: e.target.value || null })`. The hazard's raw shape predates the branch, but the branch is what INSTRUCTS the author into it (validationCopy.ts's WORKFLOW_PROMPT_BOTH entry and stepForms.ts:203-206 are both new here) and round 6 is what stopped the client flagging the resulting empty box.
speculation_rejected: Not speculation: every hop is a read literal, and the client half is executed above. The only judgement call is severity — the consequence is a broken run, not data loss; rated high because the state is reached by following the surface's own printed remedy and nothing between the click and the run says anything is wrong.

title: PROMPT_FROM_FILE_NOTE's remedy half is TRUE per validate.rs; the 'override' framing has no runtime analog but is self-correcting
evidence: Note: 'This step takes its wording from a prompt file in the workflow bundle, so there is nothing to type here. Type something to override it — but then remove the file, since a step cannot use both.' Verified: 'in the workflow bundle' matches check_prompt_files' bundle-relative contract (validate.rs:1070-1120) and the StepConfig doc (validate.rs:224). 'nothing to type here' matches has_prompt/has_file (validate.rs:681-698) — a prompt_file step is COMPLETE with no typed prompt. 'a step cannot use both' matches WORKFLOW_PROMPT_BOTH (validate.rs:683-690) exactly. 'Type something to override it' is the one loose word — nothing overrides: dispatch.rs:114 errors on both-present, and validate blocks Save — but the clause that follows ('but then remove the file') makes the instruction as a whole a correct sequence, and the reachable next screen (WORKFLOW_PROMPT_BOTH copy, validationCopy.ts:100-103) names both halves of the remedy including the off-surface one. No concrete failure mode from the wording ITSELF; the reachable defect is the empty-string state, filed as R8-1.
failure_mode: none — rejected as wording, not a defect
